changes.newText: Select System Settings from the admin sidebar menu to manage how the WebUI behaves for everyone on the server. The page has two tabs: System Settings and Configurations.
changes.newHtml: Select System Settings from the admin sidebar menu to manage how the WebUI behaves for everyone on the server. The page has two tabs: System Settings and Configurations.

changes.newText: On the System Settings tab, superadmins set the options the WebUI offers to every user in the domain, such as the available sign-in options, session creation options, and sidebar menus. Click Apply to save the changed values; Reset deletes every value saved for the domain, returning each setting to its default. JSON Config shows the current settings as JSON, and can export them to a file or import one.
